path.description: Absolute path on the configured OpenSearch server, optionally including a query string. URLs, fragments and path traversal are refused.

query.description: Additional URL query parameters. Array values repeat a parameter; they do not change the request destination.

body.description: JSON object or array, or the exact request body as a string. For bulk and multi-search, use an NDJSON string and application/x-ndjson.

contentType.description: Content type of the request body.
